findings.title: A malformed stats response crashes the Stats page, which then shows 'Loading stats…' with the old table for the previous range
findings.expected: An error message such as 'Could not load harvest stats.' and no uncaught error
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'. The page keeps showing 'Loading stats…' next to the previous range's Best plants and table, so old numbers look like results for the new range.

findings.title: A stats request that never answers leaves the page on 'Loading stats…' forever, with old results still shown
findings.expected: The request times out with an error and a way to retry, or at least the old table is not shown as current
findings.actual: 13 s after From was changed to 2026-07-01, the page still says 'Loading stats…' and shows the 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026 table and Best plants. There is no error, timeout or retry.
